scope: AB/SK, non-durum wheat, primary-elevator ambient-air aeration; Manitoba untouched

supporting_review.approval_requirement: Human approval of sourced values and applicability; no external-consultant requirement is added.

gates.required: Approve a production-origin representation and its weights, preserve each SADR total once, and resolve or explicitly exclude suppressed production and spatial conflicts.
gates.available: Pinned SADR totals and geometries; Phase 4 uniform-area proxy had no demonstrated improvement. No crop raster acquired.
gates.proposal: Evaluate a separately versioned uniform-area diagnostic only if the team accepts its limitations; it cannot establish farm locations or commercial catchments.

gates.required: Specify commodity-relevant mode(s), class speeds in km/h, dry/wet surface factors or impassability, missing-surface handling, travel budget, snapping distance and connector speed. Review barriers, turns, weight limits and snapshot completeness.
gates.available: Pinned AB/SK OSM ways; access/oneway/maxspeed tags support bounded screening. Node barriers and restriction relations are absent from the existing adapter.
gates.proposal: For bulk wheat, review an HGV vehicle profile before using the other transport modes. Treat unknown surfaces and unsupported restrictions as excluded until a documented scenario is approved.

gates.required: Approve wheat storage share, residence and operating-period ranges, treated fraction, seasonal inventory applicability, joint dependence, assignment variants and unknown-capacity policy.
gates.available: Observed all-commodity storage tonnes; temporary Phase 3 coefficients have no scientific approval.
gates.proposal: Propose nearest-first as the PRD reference and maximum-served/minimum-tonne-minute allocation as its comparison, using matched draws. Unknown capacities stay flagged; no invented zero capacity.

gates.required: Supply reviewed commercial airflow, static pressure, fan/motor efficiency, simultaneous fraction, cooling-cycle hours and auxiliary-kW ranges with compatible joint dependencies and source applicability.
gates.available: CGC/PAMI grain resistance, grain-specific test weights and a commercial-elevator bulletin support applicability review. None supplies candidate-specific inventory, geometry or fan duty. See the desk review for source limits.
gates.proposal: Use simultaneous fan duty and one-cycle electricity; exclude drying heat, startup current and unrelated machinery. Do not promote the Phase 3 hypothetical coefficients or arbitrary percentage bands.

gates.required: Approve the service-capacity comparison and priority objective, top-10 tie policy, robust inclusion threshold, summary quantiles, seed, Sobol draw count and weighting of discrete cases.
gates.available: No consumed registry field documents installed electrical aeration capacity. Top-10 is the project budget; no numeric stability threshold was approved.
gates.proposal: Keep signed comparable kW margins; require Verify-first where supply is undocumented. Show stability separately from technical magnitude and economic viability. Review inclusion-frequency ordering before scientific use.

gates.required: Review real-data ablations against the declared reference case, remaining source/temporal limits and a prospectively specified Phase 6 hindcast comparison before declaring readiness to freeze.
gates.available: Historical Phase 4 baselines/hindcast remain verified and available. They evaluated the prior model, not the new engine. No field verification or Manitoba transfer result exists.
gates.proposal: Retain new complexity only with a documented decision benefit; report not-testable when evidence is insufficient. Keep affordability, grid context and visit-window scores deferred until their sources are approved.
